title: TAP Sale and Stubborn Inflation Put Portugal's Economic Recovery Story to the… · 08 Sep
keywords: TAP privatisation, Portugal economy, Air France-KLM, Lufthansa, Portugal inflation, Eurostat, fiscal surplus, household cost of living, Portugal aviation, ECB inflation target, eurozone periphery, Portugal politics, public finances, energy inflation
notes: Portugal is navigating two defining economic challenges simultaneously: the partial privatisation of its flag carrier TAP and a household inflation rate that continues to outpace the European Central Bank's target. While Lisbon touts fiscal surpluses and falling debt as proof of sound management, many citizens remain unconvinced that macroeconomic gains are translating into daily relief. The coming months will test whether the government can sustain its credibility on both fronts.
